title: Hybrid real runs
scope: Covers e2e/real-sell.mjs, e2e/real-buy.mjs, e2e/bundler-send.mjs and e2e/safe-rescue.mjs. A passing sell executes the chain transfer and sandbox recognition. The smart-account sell passes bundlerUrl through, and the default URL is the public Candide Sepolia bundler [ref 0]; that registration sets no paymaster field [ref 1]. bundler-send.mjs uses the bundler URL the caller passes and sets no paymaster field [ref 2]. Those two bundlers are not stand-ins. No script in this set names a paymaster. The entries are the stand-ins.

anchor: .registerWallet('sepolia', WalletManagerEvmErc4337, { chainId: 11155111, provider: options.rpc, bundlerUrl: options.bundler, safeModulesVersion: '0.3.0', useNativeCoins: true })

entries.status: fake — the scripts call WDK directly
entries.mechanism: [ref 0] states that real-sell.mjs has no wallet user interface and no confirmation dialog. [ref 1] states the same for real-buy.mjs. [ref 2] sends the sell deposit from the account object. [ref 3] sends the Base user operation from the account object. [ref 4] sends the Safe rescue from the owner account.
entries.insteadOf: a person confirming the transaction in a wallet user interface
entries.doesNotProve: A green run does not prove that a wallet user interface showed the transaction or that a person confirmed it.

entries.component: DFX API host for the Sepolia sell
entries.mechanism: [ref 0] sets the sell client to https://dev.api.dfx.swiss. [ref 1] registers the protocol with environment sandbox.
entries.insteadOf: the production DFX API at https://api.dfx.swiss
entries.doesNotProve: A green run does not prove that production recognizes the deposit or books the sale.

entries.component: ERC-4337 bundler on the Base purchase and the Safe rescue
entries.mechanism: [ref 0] registers a smart-account purchase against https://bundler.invalid and sets no paymaster field. The purchase script does not submit a user operation. [ref 1] puts the same URL on the rescue account, again with no paymaster field. [ref 2] deploys and [ref 3] transfers by an owner-account transaction, not by a bundler.
entries.insteadOf: a bundler that submits a user operation, and a paymaster when one pays the gas
entries.doesNotProve: A green run does not prove that a bundler accepted a user operation or that a paymaster paid the gas.

anchor: const config = options.account === 'smart' ? { chainId: 8453, provider: options.rpc, bundlerUrl: 'https://bundler.invalid', safeModulesVersion: '0.3.0', useNativeCoins: true } : { provider: options.rpc }

entries.mechanism: When --fork-fund is set, [ref 0] writes the Base balance with anvil_setBalance or anvil_setStorageAt, and [ref 1] does the same for the rescue. A run without the flag does not take this path.
entries.insteadOf: a balance that arrived through a transfer
entries.doesNotProve: A green run that used --fork-fund does not prove the Safe received that balance through a transfer.

entries.status: fake — invented per run, a placeholder that looks real
entries.mechanism: [ref 0] builds a Swiss IBAN. The BBAN starts with clearing 00000 and twelve random digits, and the two check digits are 98 minus the mod-97 remainder of the BBAN followed by 121700. [ref 1] builds one for the EOA and a different one for the Safe. [ref 2] types the number into the IBAN field. [ref 3] selects that same number when it is already listed. [ref 4] keeps a paymentInfos response only when the request IBAN is that number.
entries.insteadOf: an IBAN of a bank account the seller holds
entries.doesNotProve: A green run does not prove that a bank would accept this number or pay the sale to an account the seller holds.
